fermenter.title: Fermenter Scale-Up (Preview)
fermenter.caveatLead: PREVIEW: first-order CSTR extrapolation from the in-vitro cuvette regime.
fermenter.caveatBody: Models the fermenter as one stirred-tank reactor with an electrode-pair active zone (4 cm² x 5 mm = 2 mL) and an inactive bulk volume. Ignores spatial field non-uniformity within the active zone, partial-pass kinetics, and any flow patterns beyond uniform mixing. Useful for ballpark scale-up estimates only, not for engineering a real fermenter protocol.
fermenter.activeFractionTip: Active zone fraction Fraction of the fermenter volume that sits between the electrode pair at any instant. Pilot electrodes are modelled as 4 cm² × 5 mm gap (2 mL active volume); larger fermenter volumes mean a smaller active fraction and less of the population sees the field per pass.
fermenter.exposureSubLow: Most cells never see the field
fermenter.exposureTip: Population exposure probability Fraction of cells that pass through the electrode-pair active zone at least once during the field-on window, modelled as a single CSTR with exponential residence-time distribution. Increases with mixing rate and field-on duration; decreases with total volume.
fermenter.effectiveTargetDrTip: Effective target DR for the fermenter population Product of the cuvette-regime predicted DR and the population exposure probability. Cells that never reached the active zone count as DR=0 in the population mean.
fermenter.hint: Increase mixing or field-on duration to raise exposure; decrease total volume to raise the active fraction. Real fermenters often need multiple electrode pairs or recirculation loops to hit uniform per-cell dosing across pilot scales (>10 L).
